label: Qwen3-TTS Voice Design
description: Text-to-speech through the GX10's FB_Qwen3TTSVoiceDesign node and SaveAudioMP3. Voices are natural-language design instructions, so the speaker control is the node's instruct input and speed is folded into that instruction as a pace hint.

inputs.instruct: A warm, grounded adult voice with a relaxed pace and clear articulation.

params.label: Speaker / voice design
params.description: A voice preset id from GET /api/tts/voices?provider=comfyui, or a free-form voice design instruction. FB_Qwen3TTSVoiceDesign has no fixed speaker list; the instruction is its documented voice control.

params.label: Language
params.description: One of the node's documented language values, or Auto.

params.label: Speed
params.description: Playback-rate hint appended to the voice instruction. FB_Qwen3TTSVoiceDesign has no numeric speed input, so this is a soft direction, not a hard time-stretch.

voices.name: Warm Narrator
voices.instruct: A warm, grounded adult voice with a relaxed pace, gentle rasp and clear articulation.

voices.name: Bright Host
voices.instruct: A bright, energetic young adult voice with crisp diction and an upbeat, welcoming tone.

voices.name: Deep Documentary
voices.instruct: A deep, authoritative middle-aged voice with measured pacing and a calm documentary delivery.

voices.name: Soft Conversational
voices.instruct: A soft, intimate conversational voice with natural pauses and a friendly, unforced tone.

voices.name: Clear Announcer
voices.instruct: A neutral, professional announcer voice with even pacing and precise pronunciation.
